## README

# ContentLite

Blueprint-driven AI content generation engine for the ACTP (Autonomous Content-to-Performance) pipeline. Generates video scripts, email newsletters, blog posts, tweets, platform descriptions, and content quality reviews — all powered by Claude.

## Architecture

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router) on Node 22
- **AI**: Anthropic Claude (via @anthropic-ai/sdk)
- **Database**: Supabase PostgreSQL
- **Testing**: Vitest
- **Deployment**: Vercel with cron jobs

## API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/health` | GET | None | Service health check |
| `/api/generate/from-blueprint` | POST | Bearer | Generate video content from a creative blueprint |
| `/api/generate/email` | POST | Bearer | Generate email newsletter from a winning creative |
| `/api/generate/blog` | POST | Bearer | Generate SEO blog post from a winning creative |
| `/api/generate/tweets` | POST | Bearer | Generate tweets for a niche+strategy |
| `/api/generate/tweet-analysis` | POST | Bearer | Analyze tweet patterns for hooks, tone, topics |
| `/api/generate/twitter-playbook` | POST | Bearer | Generate a full Twitter growth strategy playbook |
| `/api/generate/platform-descriptions` | POST | Bearer | Generate platform-specific captions (TikTok, YouTube, etc.) |
| `/api/review` | POST | Bearer | 7-dimension rubric content quality review |
| `/api/cron/generate-variants` | POST | Cron | Auto-generate content variants (every 4h) |
| `/api/cron/generate-content` | POST | Cron | Process generation queue (every 2h) |

## Setup

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Copy environment variables
cp .env.local.example .env.local
# Edit .env.local with your actual keys

# Run development server
npm run dev

# Run tests
npm test

# Build for production
npm run build
```

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | Yes | Supabase project URL |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Yes | Supabase anonymous key |
| `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | Yes | Supabase service role key |
| `CONTENTLITE_MASTER_KEY` | Yes | Master API key for auth |
| `CRON_SECRET` | Yes | Secret for cron endpoint auth |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | Yes | Anthropic API key for Claude |
| `REVIEW_MODEL` | No | Override review model (default: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) |

## Project Structure

```
app/
  api/
    health/           — Health check
    generate/
      from-blueprint/ — Video content from blueprints
      email/          — Email newsletters
      blog/           — SEO blog posts
      tweets/         — Tweet generation
      tweet-analysis/ — Tweet pattern analysis
      twitter-playbook/ — Growth strategy playbook
      platform-descriptions/ — Platform-specific captions
    review/           — Content quality review
    cron/             — Scheduled jobs
lib/
  anthropic.ts        — Shared Anthropic client
  api-helpers.ts      — Response helpers & auth middleware
  auth.ts             — API key management
  supabase.ts         — Database client
  review-engine.ts    — Content review logic
  generators/
    video-generator.ts           — Blueprint → video content
    email-generator.ts           — Creative → email
    blog-generator.ts            — Creative → blog
    tweet-generator.ts           — Niche → tweets
    tweet-analysis-generator.ts  — Tweets → pattern analysis
    twitter-playbook-generator.ts — Niche → growth playbook
    description-generator.ts     — Content → platform descriptions
tests/                — Vitest unit tests
```

judged.rationale: Buyer urgency is moderate as the demand for automated content solutions is rising, although not critical for all yet. MVP ease is relatively low due to the need for integration with multiple APIs and platforms like Supabase and Anthropic. Distribution fit is higher because this audience can effectively be reached through digital marketing channels. Retention potential is strong given the recurring need for content production. However, the idea description lacks evidence of an existing advantage such as proprietary access to specific data or a pre-existing large audience, resulting in a lower advantage score.
